meta.title: momery - durable project memory
meta.description: Plain-text long-term memory for coding agents: project cards, ranked recall, cross-project reads, and a session journal that survives context compaction.

tools.memory_brief: Recall the project card and the notes relevant to a task.
tools.memory_search: Search one project or every project for relevant notes.
tools.memory_read: Read one memory file in full, including another project's.
tools.memory_write: Record durable notes, pending items, journal blocks, and global rules.
tools.memory_status: List known projects and inspect one project in detail.
tools.memory_end: Close a session with a journal block and distilled notes.
